# bo-grid — full reference for AI code generation

This file is meant to be pasted whole into an AI assistant's context (or
fetched by an agent) before it generates code against `bo-grid`. It states
the real, current API surface — every name here exists in the published
package. If something you want isn't listed here, don't invent it: check
CHANGELOG.md or ask, rather than guessing a plausible-sounding prop name.

Package: `bo-grid` (npm). Peer dependency: `svelte@^5`. `sideEffects: false`
(unused exports tree-shake). Works with SvelteKit/SSR out of the box.

## 0. The one rule that matters most

**bo-grid ships THREE separate subpath entry points besides the main one. Importing one adds NOTHING to
the others.** Never import something from the main entry if it belongs to a
subpath — it isn't there.

```
bo-grid            → Grid component + core types/helpers (this file, §1-§4)
bo-grid/realtime    → tick/trade-stream pipeline (§5)
bo-grid/trading     → APAC market-convention helpers (§6)
bo-grid/element     → framework-agnostic <bo-grid> web component (§7)
```

## 1. Minimal usage

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Grid, type ColumnDef, type GridRow } from 'bo-grid';

  const columns: ColumnDef[] = [
    { type: 'text', key: 'symbol', header: 'Symbol', width: 120 },
    { type: 'price', key: 'price', header: 'Price', width: 90, flash: 'auto' },
    { type: 'percent', key: 'changePct', header: 'Chg %', width: 80 },
  ];

  // GridRow requires only `id`. Add your own fields.
  let rows: GridRow[] = $state([
    { id: 1, symbol: 'AAPL', price: 227.5, changePct: 1.2 },
    { id: 2, symbol: 'MSFT', price: 415.3, changePct: -0.4 },
  ]);
</script>

<Grid {rows} {columns} height={640} />
```

`height` is a **number** (the scroll viewport's pixel height; the grid's
total height is that plus header/toolbar/footer chrome) OR a **CSS string**
(`'100%'`, `'80vh'`, `'480px'`) — a string sizes the whole element and the
viewport auto-fits the remaining space (give the grid a sized parent).

## 2. `GridRow`

```ts
interface GridRow {
  id: number;
  /** Legacy row-driven flash ONLY — omit unless you use `flash: true`. */
  flashSeq?: number;
  flashDir?: 'up' | 'down';
  [field: string]: unknown; // your own data fields
}
```

**DO NOT** add `flashSeq`/`flashDir` to a row unless a column explicitly uses
the legacy `flash: true` mode. For `flash: 'auto'`/`'change'` (the normal,
recommended mode — see §4.2), the grid needs neither field.

## 3. `<Grid>` props

```ts
interface GridProps {
  rows: GridRow[];                    // required, unless using `source`
  columns: ColumnDef[];                // required — see §4
  height: number | string;             // required — see §1

  // Sizing/theming
  rowHeight?: number | ((row: GridRow, index: number) => number); // default 36
  theme?: 'dark' | 'light' | GridTheme;  // default 'dark' — see §3.1
  resizable?: boolean;                 // drag-to-resize columns, default true
  virtualizeColumns?: boolean;         // 100+ column grids, default false
  columnHover?: boolean;               // wash the column under the pointer (body + header), default false
  flashMotion?: 'fade' | 'hold' | 'auto'; // 'hold' = static tint, far cheaper on a busy board; 'auto' = fade when quiet, hold when busy; default 'fade'
  liveSort?: boolean | number;             // keep sort/filters current under patchRows: rows a tick changed in a sorted/filtered field merge back into place at most every N ms (true = 500); off by default
  pauseOnHover?: boolean;                  // liveSort waits while a mouse/pen is over the rows (default true)
  staleAfter?: number;                     // dim a row (--bo-stale-opacity) after N ms without news (a patch that changed it, or a new row object); off by default
  flashNewRows?: boolean | number;         // flash a row once when a new id arrives in rows (true = 600 ms); not copies, an empty grid's load or a wholesale replace; off by default

  // Selection
  cellSelection?: boolean;             // range-select highlight, default true
  rowSelection?: boolean;              // leading checkbox column, default false
  rowNumbers?: boolean;                // leading row-number column (1..n in view order), default false
  onRowSelectionChange?: (selectedIds: Array<string | number>) => void;
  selectedRowId?: string | number | null;   // controlled active-row highlight
  onRowClick?: (row: GridRow, event: MouseEvent | KeyboardEvent) => void;
  onCellClick?: (info: { row: GridRow; column: ColumnDef; value: unknown }, event: MouseEvent) => void;
  getRowId?: (row: GridRow) => string | number;  // default: row => row.id

  // Sort / filter
  sort?: SortState[];                  // controlled: [{ key, dir: 'asc'|'desc' }]
  onSortChange?: (sort: SortState[]) => void;
  filter?: string;                     // quick-filter search text (bind to your input)
  quickFilter?: boolean;               // built-in search box, default false
  filterRow?: boolean;                 // per-column filter inputs under header
  filterMenu?: boolean;                // per-column funnel menu (lazy-loaded)
  columnFilters?: Record<string, ColumnFilter>;   // controlled
  onFilterChange?: (filters: Record<string, ColumnFilter>) => void;

  // Grouping / tree / pivot-adjacent
  groupBy?: string[];
  aggregations?: AggKind[];            // ['sum','avg','count','min','max']
  getChildren?: (row: GridRow) => GridRow[] | undefined;  // sync tree data
  loadChildren?: (row: GridRow) => Promise<GridRow[]>;    // async (lazy) tree
  hasChildren?: (row: GridRow) => boolean;
  lazyGroups?: LazyGroup[];            // server-side group summaries
  loadGroup?: (key: string) => Promise<GridRow[]>;
  detail?: Snippet<[{ row: GridRow }]>; // master-detail expand panel
  detailHeight?: number;

  // Columns
  hiddenColumns?: string[];
  onColumnVisibilityChange?: (hidden: string[]) => void;
  columnMenu?: boolean;                // per-column ⋮ menu (sort/hide/filter)
  columnsPanel?: boolean;              // "Columns" toggle panel
  onColumnReorder?: (keys: string[]) => void;
  onColumnResize?: (key: string, width: number) => void;

  // Rows
  rowClass?: (row: GridRow) => string | undefined;  // conditional row class
  pinnedRows?: GridRow[];              // rows pinned above the scroll
  rowPinning?: boolean;                // users pin rows from the row menu (right-click), default false
  findBar?: boolean;                   // Ctrl/Cmd+F in the grid opens a find bar (displayed text, Enter/Shift+Enter), default false
  fitColumns?: boolean;                // every column scales with the grid in proportion to its width (min/maxWidth bounds), default false
  onRowPinChange?: (ids: rowId[]) => void;
  emptyMessage?: string;               // default labels.noRows
  loading?: boolean;
  rowMenu?: (row: GridRow) => Array<{ label: string; onSelect: () => void }>;
  onRowReorder?: (fromIndex: number, toIndex: number) => void;

  // Editing
  onCellEdit?: (e: { row: GridRow; column: ColumnDef; value: string | number }) => void;
  fillHandle?: boolean;                // drag-fill selection corner

  // Pagination
  pageSize?: number;
  pageSizeOptions?: number[];
  onPageSizeChange?: (size: number) => void;
  page?: number;
  onPageChange?: (page: number) => void;

  // Server-side data (huge datasets — see RowSource below)
  source?: RowSource;

  // Misc
  footer?: boolean;                    // totals row
  persistKey?: string;                 // localStorage key for layout persistence
  defaultColumn?: Partial<ColumnDef>;  // applied under every column (column + cellType win)
  cellTypes?: Record<string, CellTypeDef>;  // reusable column types: { name: { extends?: BuiltinType, ...column defaults, component? } }; columns use `cellType: 'name'` INSTEAD of `type`
  filterTypes?: Record<string, FilterTypeDef>;  // custom filter kinds: { name: { test(value, filter, row), isActive?(filter), component, needsValues? } }; editor props { filter, onChange, column, values, labels }; filter objects are { kind: name, ...fields }
  labels?: Partial<GridLabels>;        // override any built-in UI string; interpolated entries are functions, e.g. filterFor: (h) => `Lọc ${h}`
  locale?: string;                     // BCP 47; default locale for price/date/currency/relative formatting, agg bar, pager
  onReady?: (api: GridApi) => void;    // called once on mount — see §3.3
  ariaLabel?: string;
  cell?: Snippet<[{ row: GridRow; column: ColumnDef; value: unknown }]>;  // custom-cell renderer (Svelte-only — see §4.4 and §7 for non-Svelte)
}
```

### 3.1 Theming

```ts
import { themePresets, type ThemePreset } from 'bo-grid';
// themePresets: 'dark' | 'light' | 'high-contrast-dark' | 'high-contrast-light' | 'midnight' | 'terminal'
//               | 'tradecanvas' | 'tradecanvas-light'  (the TradeCanvas / TradingDek palette)
```
Or pass a full `GridTheme` token object (`themeVars`, `darkTheme`, `lightTheme` are exported for reference/extension).

### 3.2 Server-side data (`RowSource`)

For datasets too large to hold in memory: `createArraySource(rows, opts?)` wraps
an array with the windowed interface; implement `RowSource` yourself for a real
backend (`{ getRows(params: RowSourceParams): Promise<RowSourceResult> }`,
params include range/sort/filter/columnFilters).

### 3.3 The grid handle (`onReady`)

```ts
interface GridApi {
  scrollToRow(key: string | number, align?: 'nearest' | 'start' | 'center' | 'end'): boolean; // false if not in current view / source mode
  focusCell(rowKey: string | number, columnKey: string): boolean;
  getSelectedRows(): GridRow[];            // ticked rows (rowSelection), view order
  autosizeColumns(keys?: string[]): void;
  exportCSV(filename?: string): Promise<void>;  // current view (filtered + sorted)
  getState(): GridState;                   // { version, order, widths, hidden, pinned, sorts, filters } — JSON-safe
  applyState(state: unknown): boolean;     // reconciled against current columns; false for a foreign version
  refresh(): void;                         // re-run filter+sort over the whole view on current values; for an order that follows the feed, use the liveSort prop instead
  patchRows(patches: Iterable<[rowId, Partial<Row>]>): number;  // BUSY FEEDS: rows may be plain objects ($state.raw); writes in place, repaints only rendered cells whose field changed (+ row-aware ones). format/cellClass/tooltip: declare `(value, row)` ONLY if the fn reads other row fields
  flashCells(opts?: { rows?: rowId[]; columns?: string[]; dir?: 'up' | 'down'; ms?: number }): number;  // flash on-screen cells on demand (a fill, an alert), changed or not; returns rows flashed
  pinRow(id: rowId, pinned?: boolean): boolean;  // pin above the scroll (row stays in the body); false = unknown id
  getPinnedRowIds(): rowId[];
  openFind(query?: string): void;      // open the find bar (findBar), optionally searching at once
}
```
Row keys are whatever `getRowId` returns (default `row.id`). For a busy feed
(price board), keep rows as plain objects and wire
`createTickStream({ apply: (b) => api.patchRows(b) })` — ~10x cheaper per write
than mutating $state proxies; `applyPatches` + $state rows still works for light
feeds.

## 4. `ColumnDef`

Every variant shares these base fields (all optional except `key`/`header`):

```ts
interface ColBase {
  key: string;              // required — row field to read (or the sort/filter key for a computed column)
  header: string;            // required — header label
  locale?: string;           // BCP 47 for built-in price/date/currency/relative formatting; defaults to the grid's `locale`
  value?: (row: GridRow) => unknown;   // computed column — derives instead of reading row[key]
  spanRows?: boolean | ((a: GridRow, b: GridRow) => boolean);  // merge cell down over ADJACENT rows (true = equal non-blank values); hierarchical left→right; in-memory only; display only
  colSpan?: (row: GridRow) => number;  // cell covers N columns for this row; covered cells not drawn; clamped at pin boundary; ignored with virtualizeColumns
  width?: number; minWidth?: number; maxWidth?: number;
  flex?: number;              // flex-grow weight instead of a fixed width
  align?: 'left' | 'right';   // side for header + cells + footer; default right for number types, left otherwise
  cellClass?: string | ((value: unknown, row: GridRow) => string | undefined);
  headerClass?: string;
  headerTooltip?: string; headerInfo?: boolean;

  flash?: boolean | 'auto' | 'up-down' | 'change';   // §4.2 — use 'auto', not true
  flashMs?: number;           // derived-mode flash duration, default 300
  flashColor?: boolean;       // default true; false = flash background only, keep the column's text colour (price-limit tones)
  showChange?: boolean | { format?: (delta: number, row: GridRow) => string; ms?: number };
                              // '▲0.15' / '▼0.15' beside the value, held then faded (default 1000 ms), in the
                              // column's format; gives way first in a narrow column; use on 1–2 key columns only

  sortable?: boolean;         // default true
  compare?: (a: unknown, b: unknown) => number;
  groupAgg?: AggKind;
  pinned?: boolean | 'left' | 'right';
  editable?: boolean;
  validate?: (value: string | number, row: GridRow) => boolean;
  options?: string[];         // editable <select> choices
  tooltip?: boolean | ((value: unknown, row: GridRow) => string);
  wrap?: boolean;
  format?: (value: unknown, row?: GridRow) => string;   // custom display formatter
  render?: (ctx: { value: unknown; row: GridRow; column: ColumnDef }) => string | Node | null | undefined;  // JS cell renderer (framework-agnostic — §4.4)
  component?: Component<{ value: unknown; row: GridRow; column: ColumnDef; text: string }>;  // Svelte cell renderer, display-only
  editor?: Component<{ value; row; column; seed: string | null; commit(value: unknown): void; cancel(): void }>;  // custom in-cell editor (needs editable: true); makes display types editable
  parse?: (raw: string, row: GridRow) => unknown;  // typed/pasted text → stored value; undefined/NaN rejects
  resizable?: boolean;
  autoWidth?: boolean;         // widen when an on-screen value no longer fits (grow-only, checked every 500 ms; maxWidth caps)
  group?: string;              // spanning header group label
  filter?: false | 'text' | 'number' | 'date' | 'set' | string;   // string = name of a registered filterTypes entry

  // Conditional formatting (numeric columns only)
  dataBar?: { min?: number; max?: number; color?: string; negative?: string };
  icons?: Array<{ at: number; icon: string; tone?: 'up'|'down'|'amber'|'info'|'neutral' }>;
  colorScale?: { min?: number; mid?: number; max?: number; colors?: [string,string] | [string,string,string] };
}
```

### 4.1 `type` variants (discriminated union — pick one per column)

```
'text'      sub?: string                                    plain text (+ optional subtitle)
'price'     —                                                fixed 2-decimal number (use bo-grid/trading's
                                                               fmtTradingPrice for tick-aware precision instead)
'percent'   —                                                "+1.20%" style
'volume'    —                                                1.2K / 3.4M / 5.6B compact number
'number'    decimals?: number                                fixed-decimal number
'date'      dateStyle?: 'short' | 'medium'                   epoch ms → localized date
'currency'  currency?: string; locale?: string; decimals?    Intl.NumberFormat currency
'relative'  —                                                epoch ms → "3 hours ago"
'heatmap'   min: number; max: number; decimals?: number      fixed heat-ramp background (required min/max)
'sparkline' sparkKey: string                                 canvas candlestick sparkline (value at sparkKey: Candle[])
'progress'  min?: number; max?: number                       progress bar
'rating'    max?: number                                     star rating
'tags'      —                                                value: string[] or comma-separated string
'badge'     tones?: Record<string, BadgeTone>                pill badge; BadgeTone = 'up'|'down'|'amber'|'info'|'neutral'
'boolean'   trueLabel?: string; falseLabel?: string           ✓ / ✕
'avatar'    sub?: string                                     initials avatar + name
'link'      href?: (row) => string; newTab?: boolean          sanitized anchor (blocks javascript:/data:)
'custom'    —                                                render via the `cell` snippet or `render()` hook
```

### 4.2 Realtime flash — the pattern to always use

```ts
{ type: 'price', key: 'price', header: 'Price', flash: 'auto' }
```
```ts
row.price = next;  // that's the WHOLE update. No other code needed.
```

The grid tracks each cell's own last value (keyed on row id + column) and
flashes green on a rise, red on a fall, automatically. It never flashes on
first paint or when a row scrolls into view.

**DO NOT** generate this legacy pattern unless the user explicitly asks for
row-driven (`flash: true`) flash:
```ts
// ANTI-PATTERN — do not generate this for a new column:
row.flashDir = next >= row.price ? 'up' : 'down';
row.price = next;
row.flashSeq++;
```
`'change'` instead of `'auto'` gives a neutral flash on any change (status,
text, not just numeric up/down).

### 4.3 Custom cells (Svelte)

```svelte
{#snippet cell({ row, column, value })}
  <span class:up={row.changePct > 0}>{row.changePct > 0 ? '▲' : '▼'}</span>
{/snippet}
<Grid {rows} {columns} {cell} height={640} />
```

### 4.4 Custom cells (React/Vue/vanilla/`<bo-grid>`) — use `render`, not `cell`

Svelte snippets don't exist outside Svelte. From any other framework, give a
column a `render(ctx)` function instead:
```ts
{ type: 'custom', key: 'status', render: ({ value }) => {
    const span = document.createElement('span');
    span.textContent = value === 'up' ? '● Live' : '○ Idle';
    return span; // a returned Node is safe; a returned STRING is set via innerHTML — sanitize it yourself
  } }
```

## 5. `bo-grid/realtime` — feed pipeline (own budget, ~2 KB gzip)

```ts
import { createTickStream, createRowIndex, applyPatches, TickBuffer, TradeTape, centeredWindow, createViewportSubscriptions } from 'bo-grid/realtime';
```

**Price feed** (coalesces per key, drains a bounded slice per animation
frame — use this instead of writing every socket message straight to
`$state`, which stalls the tab under load):
```ts
const index = createRowIndex(rows, (r) => r.symbol);   // Map<key, row>, O(1) lookup
const stream = createTickStream<string, Partial<Quote>>({
  apply: (batch) => applyPatches(index, batch),  // called ≤ once per frame, ≤ cap entries
  cap: 400,                                       // max row writes per frame, default 400
  onError: (err) => console.error(err),            // optional; default: rethrows async
});
stream.start();
socket.onmessage = (e) => stream.push(JSON.parse(e.data).symbol, JSON.parse(e.data));
// stream.pending  → patches waiting for a frame (climbing = feed outrunning the screen)
// stream.applied  → successfully-applied count (a batch whose apply() threw is not counted)
// stream.stop() / stream.flushNow()
```
Per key, only the LATEST patch is applied — intermediate values collapse.
This is correct for a price board; do NOT use it for a trade tape (every
trade must show) — use `TradeTape` instead.

**Trade tape** (time & sales — nothing coalesces, capped ring buffer, O(1) push):
```ts
const tape = new TradeTape<Trade>(500);   // capacity must be a positive integer; default 500
socket.onmessage = (e) => tape.push(JSON.parse(e.data));
rows = tape.toArray();   // newest-first snapshot — call once per render, not per trade
```

**Stream only the symbols on screen** (the grid reports its viewport; the
helper diffs it into subscribe / unsubscribe calls):
```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  const subs = createViewportSubscriptions({
    key: (row) => row.symbol,
    subscribe: (syms) => socket.send(JSON.stringify({ op: 'sub', syms })),
    unsubscribe: (syms) => socket.send(JSON.stringify({ op: 'unsub', syms })),
    delay: 150,                                   // ms a view must hold before it applies; default 150, 0 = at once
  });
  onDestroy(subs.clear);                          // unsubscribe everything
</script>
<Grid {rows} {columns} onViewportChange={subs.update} />
```
`onViewportChange(view)` → `{ first, last, rows }`: the data rows on screen
plus the small rendered buffer, in view order; fires when that set changes
(scroll, sort, filter, new data), never for a value-only tick. The first view
subscribes at once; `subs.flush()` applies a pending change; `subs.active` is
the subscribed key set.

**Price ladder windowing** (centered/scroll-locked view over more levels
than fit on screen — this is array-slicing math, not scroll control):
```ts
const { start, end } = centeredWindow(totalLevels, centerIndex, visibleCount);
const visible = levels.slice(start, end);   // feed THIS to <Grid rows>, not the full array
```
Keep "scroll-lock" state (`lockedCenter: number | null`) in your own
component — `null` follows the live center, a number freezes the window.

## 6. `bo-grid/trading` — APAC market conventions (own budget, ~1.5 KB gzip)

Pure functions only — no `ColumnDef`/Grid changes. Wire results into a column
via `render`/`cell` (§4.3/§4.4).

```ts
import { resolveTone, toneColor, vnBands, vnTickSize, roundToTick, vnBandPercent, vnFuturesBands, VN_FUTURES_TICK,
         fmtTradingPrice, decimalsForTick, sessionStateAt, sessionLabel, VN_HOSE_SCHEDULE } from 'bo-grid/trading';
```

**Price-limit tone** (the ceiling/floor/reference/up/down colour convention
VN/TH terminals use — NOT plain up/down):
```ts
const bands = vnBands(row.ref, 'HOSE');   // 'HOSE' | 'HNX' | 'UPCOM', default 'HOSE'
                                            // → { ref, ceiling, floor } — tick-rounded (ceiling DOWN, floor UP)
const tone = resolveTone(row.price, bands);   // 'ceiling' | 'floor' | 'ref' | 'up' | 'down'
const color = toneColor(tone);                 // darkToneColors by default; toneColor(tone, lightToneColors) on light themes; or a partial override
```
`vnTickSize(price, exchange?)` — HOSE steps 10 → 50 → 100 VND by price tier;
HNX/UPCOM flat 100 VND. `roundToTick(price, tick, 'down'|'up'|'nearest')`.
`vnFuturesBands(ref)` — VN30 index futures: ±7% on a 0.1-point step
(`VN_FUTURES_TICK`), ceiling DOWN, floor UP.

**Tick-aware formatting** (the built-in `price` column type is a fixed 2
decimals — wrong for whole-VND or a 4-decimal FX pip):
```ts
fmtTradingPrice(68500, vnTickSize(68500, 'HOSE'));  // "68,500" — 0 decimals for a whole-VND tick
```

**Session state** (evaluated via `Intl` in the exchange's own time zone —
correct for a viewer anywhere, not just Vietnam):
```ts
sessionStateAt(new Date(), VN_HOSE_SCHEDULE);
// → 'pre-open' | 'ato' | 'continuous' | 'break' | 'atc' | 'closed'
```

## 7. `bo-grid/element` — framework-agnostic `<bo-grid>` web component

For React, Vue, Angular, or vanilla JS. Registers `<bo-grid>` as a custom
element and takes the ENTIRE `<Grid>` API through one `config` object
(bundle includes the Svelte runtime, so it's larger than the native import —
~80 KB gzip; if you're already in Svelte, import `Grid` directly instead).

```ts
import { createBoGrid } from 'bo-grid/element';   // registers <bo-grid>, injects styles
import type { BoGridConfig } from 'bo-grid/element';

const config: BoGridConfig = { columns, rows, theme: 'dark', height: 520 };
document.body.append(createBoGrid(config));
// or: el.config = config;  — config is safe to set AFTER the element attaches
// (blank grid until config arrives, then reacts — no crash). Use createBoGrid
// or set config in a useEffect/onMounted — never assume it exists synchronously.
```
Client-only (needs the DOM) — guard SSR with a dynamic import. Renders to
light DOM (no shadow root), so `--bo-*`/page CSS applies normally. Custom
cells from non-Svelte code use a column's `render(ctx)` — see §4.4.

## 8. Main-entry (`bo-grid`) standalone exports

```ts
// Formatters
fmtPrice, fmtPercent, fmtVolume, fmtDate, fmtCurrency, relativeTime

// Data helpers
aggregate(values: number[]) → {sum,avg,count,min,max} | null (empty → null)
heatColor(value, min, max), pivot(rows, config)

// Registered cell types (same resolution the grid does; feed to toCSV/printTable/pivot)
resolveColumns(columns, cellTypes?, locale?) → ColumnDef[]

// Merged cells (pure planning, for custom renderers)
buildMergePlan({ columns, count, rowAt, sectionOf, breakAfter?, colSpan? }) → MergePlan | null, colSpanRow(columns, row, sectionOf)

// Localization & layout state
DEFAULT_LABELS, resolveLabels(overrides?) → GridLabels
reconcileState(saved, columnKeys) → GridState | null, GRID_STATE_VERSION

// Theming
themeVars, darkTheme, lightTheme, highContrastDark, highContrastLight,
midnightTheme, terminalTheme, tradecanvasTheme, tradecanvasLightTheme, themePresets

// Sparkline canvas primitives (draw your own candlestick canvas)
drawCandles(ctx, candles, w, h, colors?), setupHiDpiCanvas(canvas, cssW, cssH)

// Export / import (CSV dependency-free; XLSX dynamic-imports the optional `xlsx` peer)
toCSV(rows, columns, opts?) → string
exportCSV(filename, rows, columns, opts?)   // filename is FIRST — triggers a browser download
exportXLSX(filename, rows, columns, opts?)  // async; filename FIRST; dynamic-imports `xlsx` (install it as a peer)
parseCSV(text, columns?), parseCSVMatrix(text), parseTSV(text, columns?),
parseJSON(text), parseRows(text, columns?)  // auto-detects JSON/TSV/CSV — good for a paste handler
rowsFromObjects(objects)

// Print / full-data HTML (renders ALL rows, unlike the virtualized grid)
toHTMLTable(rows, columns), printTable(rows, columns, opts?), escapeHTML(s)

// Server-side / windowed data source
createArraySource(rows, opts?)
```

## 9. Things an AI assistant commonly gets wrong — check before you emit code

1. Importing a realtime/trading export from `'bo-grid'` instead of its
   subpath (`'bo-grid/realtime'` etc.) — it will not exist there. bo-grid has
   NO charts entry — it is a grid-only library; standalone charts live in the
   separate TradeCanvas library.
2. Writing `flashSeq++`/`flashDir =` bookkeeping for a NEW column — use
   `flash: 'auto'` instead (§4.2). Only reach for `flash: true` if asked for
   the legacy row-driven mode explicitly.
3. Using the Svelte `cell` snippet from React/Vue/vanilla code — snippets
   don't exist outside Svelte; use `render(ctx)` (§4.4).
4. Coalescing a trade tape's individual trades with `createTickStream`
   (which is last-write-wins per key) — a trade tape needs `TradeTape`
   instead, because every trade must show (§5).
5. Assuming `GridRow` needs `flashSeq`/`flashDir` — it doesn't, unless using
   legacy `flash: true` (§2).
6. Setting `<bo-grid>`'s `config` before the element is guaranteed attached
   without checking the docs' safe pattern — use `createBoGrid` or a
   framework's post-mount hook (§7).
7. Inventing a `ColumnDef`/`GridProps` field not listed in §3/§4 — the full
   prop surface is listed above; if a name isn't there, it doesn't exist.
